Non-accidental major/minor surgeries/admissions: 12 months.
Neo-natal, prematurity and congenital conditions: 12 months.
Newly diagnosed chronic conditions, declared pre-existing and/or chronic conditions, organ transplant, HIV/AIDS and related conditions, cataract operation: 12 months.

Scope of cover. Hospitalisation necessitating medical and/or surgical intervention to the insured as a result of accidental bodily injury and/or illness and/or a disease within the period of insurance, subject to the policy terms and conditions.

ul.li: Adults: 19 to 65 years; last joining age 60.
Children: from birth (a term baby of 38 weeks) up to 18 years.
Seniors (61 to 100 years): refer to GA's Hadhi Plan (last joining age 75; not applicable to existing members).
Illness admission: 30 days. Covid-19, if purchased: 30 days.
Accident-related admission: no waiting period.
Non-accidental major/minor surgeries/admissions: 12 months.
Neo-natal, prematurity and congenital conditions: 12 months.
Newly diagnosed chronic conditions, declared pre-existing and/or chronic conditions, organ transplant, HIV/AIDS and related conditions, cataract operation: 12 months.
Maternity complications/normal delivery: 10 months.

field.p: Territorial limits. Kenya only, extended to worldwide (excluding the UK, USA and Canada) while on business or holiday, up to 8 weeks from the date of travel.

ul.li: Pre-authorisation is required for all admissions, including treatment outside Kenya.
Private doctors are paid as per GA panel rates.
Claims incurred outside the GA panel are payable on a reimbursement basis.

Scheduled admissions: advise GA 48 hours before admission by sharing the pre-authorisation form; GA issues a letter of undertaking; on admission present the letter of undertaking, NHIF card and GA membership card.

Emergency admissions: identify yourself to the hospital with the GA membership card; the hospital shares a pre-authorisation form within 24 hours; GA issues a letter of undertaking; on discharge, fill and sign the claim form/invoice.

field.p: Overseas treatment. Notify GA before any overseas treatment. Expenses are settled on a reimbursement basis; the economy air ticket is refunded for treatment not locally available in Kenya; claims are reimbursed in Kenya Shillings at the exchange rate on the date of the claim.

Reimbursement. Send GA, within 60 days of discharge, a fully filled and signed inpatient claim form, original receipts as proof of payment, the discharge summary, a medical report and the final itemised hospital bill.
How to sign up. A fully filled application form, copies of ID/passport, KRA PIN and next of kin's ID, and proof of premium payment.

ul.li: Non-declared pre-existing conditions.
War and kindred risks (whether war be declared or not); naval, military or air force operations; participation in riots, strikes and civil commotion.
Self-referred or self-prescribed treatment.
Intentional self-injury, suicide or attempted suicide, or any bodily injury or illness wilfully self-inflicted or due to negligence.
Alcohol and substance abuse.
Cosmetic or beauty treatment in nature cure clinics or health hydros.
Cost of providing, maintaining or fitting an external prosthesis or appliance or other equipment, except wheelchairs, walking frames and crutches.
Alternative medicine, excluding Ayurvedic.
Diagnostic equipment and/or specialised surgical devices and gadgets.
Treatment other than by a registered (KMPDU) medical practitioner.
Participation in professional and hazardous sports, e.g. bungee jumping, paragliding.
Nutritional supplements, unless prescribed as part of treatment of specified medical conditions.
Family planning and fertility treatment, any form of assisted conception and complications, e.g. treatment related to infertility and impotence, hormonal imbalance, hormone replacement therapy (HRT).
All expenses related to donor screening and treatment, including surgery to remove organs from a donor.
Claims arising from or associated with epidemics/pandemics or unknown diseases, unless purchased.
Expenses recoverable under any other insurance, e.g. GPA, WIBA, NHIF.
Outpatient-related expenses, including maternity, dental and optical.
Expenses related to weight loss/gain, including obesity.
Treatment arising from contamination by radioactivity from nuclear fuel, waste or fission.
Expenses incurred as a result of natural calamities such as volcanic eruptions, earthquakes and typhoons.
Expenses/claims incurred in the USA, UK and Canada.
